name: Portal Heart
source:
You are a hero who has fallen in the battle against darkness.
You have been given a second chance - don't waste it.​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/portal-heart-v1-0-scarsor.129241/]F95 Zone[/url]]
translation:
你是個在對抗黑暗的戰鬥中倒下的英雄。
如今你得到了第二次機會——別浪費它。
